text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Year Summer Training Camp for 
Sounds of Earth was finally beginning. 
Upon safely arriving at the camp lodge—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! I'll carry this summer all the 
way to the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's beginning to resonate. The 
ever-shifting melody.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I suppose you could say: look 
forward to autumn.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then let us dedicate ourselves as well. 
Toward the Sapporo Kinen...!
